name: sbml
title: SBML model → COPASI → quality
question: Build an SBML kinetic model of a linear metabolic pathway A→B→C that COPASI can load and simulate to a valid steady state, with total mass conserved and the terminal product C accumulating as the dominant species.
biological_summary: An SBML kinetic model (libsbml) of the pathway A→B→C with mass-action reactions, loaded and simulated in the REAL COPASI backend (basico, via viva-copasi).
conclusion:
## Final model
An SBML kinetic model of A→B→C (mass-action), loaded + simulated in COPASI (basico) via viva-copasi.

## Result
DONE (5/5) — the LLM agent authored the reaction network, recognising after A→B that the pathway stopped at B and adding B→C so the terminal product accumulates. Every verdict is from real COPASI simulation (validity, load, steady state, conservation, terminal product). The deterministic policy GAVE UP at 0/5: authoring an SBML network is not an install. See docs/sbml-agent-vs-policy.html.
